title: Szymon Warszavski - Social Security NUMIDENT index
description: Indexed NUMIDENT extraction displayed on authenticated FamilySearch page; no underlying SS-5 image available. Gives birth April 1, 1918 in Warsaw, Poland; June 1963 social program application; Cleveland; death July 18, 1995; parents indexed as Joseph Warszavski and Rochel Goldberg. Same death date as original 1995 obituary supports identity. Parent spellings and birth details require original SS-5 or other independent record.

title: Elka Kagan Zelkind - Social Security NUMIDENT index
description: Authenticated indexed page screenshot inspected; no original SS-5 image. Elka Kagan Zelkind (alias Elka Kagan Kaga), birth November 12, 1913 in indexed "Bubruysk, Soviet Union" (the Soviet Union label is anachronistic for 1913), April 29, 1981 application, Cleveland, death March 14, 2005. Indexed parents Isac Kaga and Tsilya Gershon. Ohio death index gives paternal surname Kogan; Kaga/Kagan/Kogan are unverified variants, not merged into a legal maiden name.

title: Zion Memorial Park burial register - Warszawski and Zelkind surname results

description: Cemetery-operated last-name search inspected September 25, 2026. Warszawski: BERTHA interred Nov 29, 2016, Z6 row 1 grave 58. Zelkind: ELKA interred March 16, 2005, Z6 row 4 grave 110; MORDUKH interred Sept 25, 1996, Z6 row 6 grave 110; GAIL interred Feb 1, 2013, Z6 row 4 grave 111. Interment dates, not death dates; cemetery cautions typos/human error. Gail relationship unproved. Hersh search: ILEEN interred May 24, 2009, Z3 row 1 grave 34; LAWRENCE interred Jan 3, 2012, Z3 row 1 grave 35; duplicate Jan 5 RESERVE line at same grave is not a separate burial.
